label: nodokaspecial30p1
title_zh: 变形虫（无可辩驳的怪异）

lines.en: label nodokaspecial30p1:
scene sky
It’s a perfectly normal morning.
lines.zh: 这是个再普通不过的早晨。

lines.en: But it isn’t perfectly normal for long as the first thing I see when I step outside (Apart from an obnoxiously blue sky) is a name on my caller ID I am not yet prepared to deal with this early in the morning.
lines.zh: 但这份普通没能维持多久——我踏出家门，首先看到的（除了一片蓝得让人恼火的天空），是来电显示上一个我还没准备好在这么早面对的名字。

lines.en: And yet I tap on the answer button as my breakfast today was small and gorging myself on attention might assist in making up for that.
lines.zh: 可我还是按下了接听键。毕竟今天的早餐分量太少，也许靠狼吞虎咽地吞食别人的关注，多少能补回来一点。

lines.en: : Good morning, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 早上好，Nodoka。

lines.en: : And good morning to you as well, Father.
lines.zh: : 也祝您早上好，父亲。

lines.en: : I am not your father.
lines.zh: : 我不是你父亲。

lines.en: : But wouldn’t it be great if you were?
lines.zh: : 可如果您是的话，那该多好呀？

lines.en: : Not really, no. One semi-daughter is enough for me. And I'm sure Ami is a much better cook than you anyway.
lines.zh: : 一点也不好。有半个女儿就够我受的了。而且我敢肯定，Ami 的厨艺怎么说也比你好。

lines.en: : Unfortunate. But tell me, do you have anything planned for the rest of the day? And perhaps tomorrow as well?
lines.zh: : 真是遗憾。不过请告诉我，今天剩下的时间您有什么安排吗？明天也算上？

lines.en: : Am I being invited to something?
lines.zh: : 这是在邀请我去什么地方吗？

lines.en: : You are. And I solemnly swear it will not be a locker room this time.
lines.zh: : 正是。而且我郑重发誓，这次绝对不会是更衣室。

lines.en: : Is this another set-up?
lines.zh: : 又是你摆的局？

lines.en: : Why, yes. But it’s also not what you’re thinking.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，是的。不过也不完全是您想的那样。

lines.en: : You see, I’ve decided to play matchmaker this morning and set up my roommate with Rin as it has been far too long without the two of them engaging in coitus and the lesbian energy is burning a hole in my brain.
lines.zh: : 您瞧，我今早决定当一回月老，把我的室友和 Rin 撮合到一块儿——她们俩已经太久没行过那档子事了，那股百合能量快要把我的脑子烧出一个洞。

lines.en: : And, this may come as a surprise to you, but I just so happen to need my brain for brain stuff.
lines.zh: : 而且，您也许会吃惊，可我偏偏还需要用我的脑子去想事情。

lines.en: : You realize you aren’t exactly playing “matchmaker” if the two of them are already together, right?
lines.zh: : 你该不会以为，她们俩都已经在一起了，这还能叫“撮合”吧？

lines.en: : I suppose. But I’ll take it as a win so long as one of the two winds up with a tongue inside of them tonight. And no, I am not referring to the one that already lives inside of their mouths.
lines.zh: : 也许是吧。但只要今晚她们俩中有一个被舌头钻进去，我就算赢了。不，我指的不是本来就在她们嘴里的那条。

lines.en: : Weird. But why do you need me?
lines.zh: : 怪人。可你要我在场干什么？

lines.en: : So I don’t wind up as a third wheel of course.
lines.zh: : 当然是为了不让我变成电灯泡。

lines.en: : Additionally, there’s a bit of a detour we need to take on the way to hopeful lesbian intercourse and it’s one I’d thoroughly enjoy having you there for.
lines.zh: : 另外，在通往那场前途光明的百合性事的路上，我们得绕个小弯，而我很希望您能陪我一起走这一趟。

lines.en: : How quickly can you make it to the station near our school?
lines.zh: : 你最快多久能赶到我们学校附近那个车站？

lines.en: : I haven’t even said yes yet.
lines.zh: : 我还没答应呢。

lines.en: : Then I will say it for you. Yes. Now, how quickly can you make it to the station near our school?
lines.zh: : 那我就替您答应了。好的。那么，您最快多久能赶到学校附近那个车站？

lines.en: : Nodoka-
lines.zh: : Nodoka——

lines.en: : Excellent. We’ll wait there, then.
lines.zh: : 太好了。那我们就在这儿等您。

lines.en: : I look forward to seeing you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我很期待与您见面，Sensei。

lines.en: : Just as you should look forward to what you will see.
lines.zh: : 就像您也该期待您即将看到的东西一样。

lines.en: scene black
Nodoka hangs up the phone and...it looks like I don’t have much of a say in what I’m going to do today.
lines.zh: Nodoka 挂断了电话……看来我今天要做些什么，根本由不得我做主。

lines.en: As I make my way to the station, I wonder what sort of push is necessary to get Rin and Otoha to finally take the next step in their relationship.
lines.zh: 在走向车站的路上，我不禁琢磨，到底得推上哪一把，才能让 Rin 和 Otoha 的关系再往前迈一步。

lines.en: There’s a tinge of jealousy of course as I, regretfully, won’t be involved. But more than anything, there’s an overflowing curiosity of what Nodoka plans to do in order to enable this.
lines.zh: 当然也有一丝嫉妒——很遗憾，这事儿没我的份。但更多的是满溢的好奇：Nodoka 究竟打算怎么做，才能促成这件事。

lines.en: Being a male, I’m obviously no expert when it comes to lesbian relationships, but I’m pretty sure most of them don’t require a team of onlookers in order to kick off.
lines.zh: 身为男性，我显然算不上百合恋情的行家，但我敢肯定，绝大多数的百合关系并不需要一群围观者才能开场。

lines.en: There’s really no point in thinking about any of this. These are all just thoughts I use to occupy the blank space in time between places A and B.
lines.zh: 想这些其实毫无意义。它们不过是我用来填塞从 A 点到 B 点之间那段空白时间的念头罢了。

lines.en: Not just because the world will move regardless of whether or not I want it to-
lines.zh: 不只因为无论我愿不愿意，世界都会照常运转——

lines.en: But because Nodoka is always so many steps ahead of me that I can never figure out what she’s plotting to begin with.
lines.zh: 更因为 Nodoka 永远比我领先那么多步，我根本猜不透她一开始在盘算什么。

lines.en: scene nodokatrain1
Upon arriving at the station, I am greeted by two surprised expressions and one oozing a disturbing sense of both pride and accomplishment.
lines.zh: 抵达车站时，迎接我的是两张惊讶的脸，以及一张散发着令人不安的自豪与成就感的表情。

lines.en: : Sensei? What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : Sensei？您怎么在这儿？

lines.en: : Good question, Otoha. Ask your roommate.
lines.zh: : 问得好，Otoha。问你室友去。

lines.en: scene nodokatrain2
: Nodoka, what-
lines.zh: : Nodoka，这到底——

lines.en: : I invited him, of course. Three is such an odd number, don’t you think? And quite literally at that.
lines.zh: : 当然是我请他来的。三这个数字太别扭了，您不觉得吗？从字面意义上也是。

lines.en: : Four is much more balanced. Plus it prevents me from becoming a third wheel.
lines.zh: : 四要平衡得多。再说，这样我就不会变成电灯泡。

lines.en: : How would you be the third wheel when you’re the one who invited us? Otoha and I are only coming along because we want to support you.
lines.zh: : 你才是邀请我们的那个人，怎么会变成电灯泡？我和 Otoha 来只是为了支持你。

lines.en: : Support her in what? I still don’t know what we’re doing.
lines.zh: : 支持她做什么？我到现在还不知道我们要干什么。

lines.en: scene nodokatrain3
: Nodoka’s new book just came out a week ago and she’s doing a signing downtown today.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 的新书一周前刚出版，她今天要在市中心办签售会。

lines.en: : Neither one of us have read it, but we were promised free food and didn’t have anything else to do, so...yeah.
lines.zh: : 我们俩谁都没读过，但她答应请我们吃免费的，而且也没别的事可做，所以……嗯。

lines.en: : So I take it this “detour” she mentioned on the phone is the main event after all?
lines.zh: : 这么说来，她电话里提到的那个“绕道”才是真正的主角？

lines.en: : Well, excuse me for being humble. You wouldn’t have come along if I’d done nothing but toot my own horn over the phone and, as my surrogate father, I wanted you to be here for this.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，恕我谦逊了一回。要是我只在电话里自吹自擂，您肯定不会来。而作为我的代理父亲，我希望您能到场见证。

lines.en: : I think you’ll come to be quite proud of me by the end of the day, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我觉得在今天结束之前，您会为我感到相当骄傲的，Sensei。

lines.en: : So, the goal was to make me proud and not that other thing you said on the phone?
lines.zh: : 所以你的目标是让我骄傲，而不是电话里说的那件事？

lines.en: scene nodokatrain4
: Can it not be both?
lines.zh: : 两者不能兼得吗？

lines.en: : I’m confused. What did you tell Sensei on the phone?
lines.zh: : 我糊涂了。你在电话里跟 Sensei 说了什么？

lines.en: : It’s probably best for everyone if we didn’t talk about that.
lines.zh: : 为了大家好，这事最好还是别谈了。

lines.en: : Welp, that about answers that question. I suddenly know where this is going.
lines.zh: : 好吧，这差不多等于回答了。我突然知道事情要往哪儿发展了。

lines.en: : I just kind of figured with today being, you know, an actual big event for you that you had a different motivation in mind this time.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，今天对你来说好歹是个真正的大日子，这次你心里应该想着别的动机。

lines.en: scene nodokatrain5
: Am I seriously the only person who doesn’t know what’s going on right now?
lines.zh: : 该不会只有我一个人完全不知道现在在发生什么吧？

lines.en: : It doesn’t matter at the end of the day. We already signed up for this and I’d feel weird backing down on supporting Nodoka just because she is once again thinking...Nodoka things.
lines.zh: : 归根结底无所谓。我们已经答应了，光因为 Nodoka 又在想……Nodoka 式的事情就临阵退缩，不去支持她，我会觉得过意不去。

lines.en: : We’re still getting free food, though...right? Because if that was a lie, I’m going to punch someone. And process of elimination says that person would have to be Sensei.
lines.zh: : 不过免费的那顿饭还是有的，对吧？因为如果那是骗人的，我可要揍人了。而排除法告诉我们，那个人只能是 Sensei。

lines.en: : How? Why? No.
lines.zh: : 怎么？凭什么？不。

lines.en: : Don’t even worry about it, Rin. Look at it this way — Sensei being here means that the two of us can hang out more and that the two of them can keep having their weird...father-daughter thing.
lines.zh: : 别管了，Rin。换个角度想——Sensei 在这儿，我们俩就能多待在一起，他们俩也能继续搞他们那套奇怪的……父女游戏。

lines.en: : Why is everyone so set on making me Nodoka’s dad?
lines.zh: : 为什么所有人都这么执着于让我当 Nodoka 的爸爸？

lines.en: : Don’t I look cute in this suit, Papa? Don’t you want to just tear it off and play with me before Mommy comes home?
lines.zh: : 爸爸，我穿这身西装是不是很可爱？您难道不想在妈妈回家之前，把它撕开，好好玩弄我一番吗？

lines.en: : Yes, but that is beside the point.
lines.zh: : 想，但这不是重点。

lines.en: scene nodokatrain6
: It doesn’t have to be...
lines.zh: : 也不一定非得是重点……

lines.en: : And on that note, I’m walking over to the platform. Rin, if you’d be so kind as to accompany me?
lines.zh: : 既然话都说到这份上了，我去站台那边走走。Rin，赏脸陪我一起吗？

lines.en: : Sorry, Sensei...Duty calls. Enjoy your daughter, though.
lines.zh: : 抱歉啦，Sensei……职责所在。不过好好享受您女儿吧。

lines.en: scene nodokatrain7
: Shall we head out as well? Or do you want to wait for the next train and give the two of them some breathing room?
lines.zh: : 我们也该出发了吧？还是要等下一班车，给她们俩留点喘息的空间？

lines.en: : Don’t you have a book signing to get to? I figured you’d be in a rush.
lines.zh: : 你不是还有签售会要赶吗？我以为你会很急。

lines.en: : It’s my signing. It’s not as if they can do it without me. Besides, I have plenty of readers who’d sit there for days while waiting for me. I’m kind of a big deal.
lines.zh: : 那是我的签售会。他们总不能撇下我自己办。再说了，愿意坐上几天几夜等我的读者多得是。我可是个大人物。

lines.en: scene nodokatrain8
: Look- I’ve got a purse and everything. There isn’t even anything in it. I am literally only carrying this because it makes me look the part.
lines.zh: : 您瞧——我连手提包都备好了。里面其实什么都没装。我带着它，纯粹是为了让自己看起来像那么回事。

lines.en: : Nodoka, be honest. Why did you want me here for this? You’ve never shown me any of your writing before. Why do you just now want me to be “proud” of you? That can’t be it, right?
lines.zh: : Nodoka，老实说。你为什么想让我来？你的作品你从来没给我看过。为什么偏偏现在想要我为你“骄傲”？事情没那么简单，对吧？

lines.en: scene nodokatrain9
: Maybe I’ve fallen for you?
lines.zh: : 说不定我已经爱上您了呢？

lines.en: : Are you even capable of that?
lines.zh: : 你还会那个？

lines.en: : Who knows? Maybe we’ll find out today.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢？也许今天我们就知道了。

lines.en: : Nodoka-
lines.zh: : Nodoka——

lines.en: : A good author won’t just explain the plot, Sensei. A good author lets the reader find out on their own.
lines.zh: : 好书不会把剧情直接讲出来，Sensei。好书会让读者自己去发现。

lines.en: : If you want to know what it is I want...or what I’m hoping to gain by dragging you along with me, why not just spend a little more time reading?
lines.zh: : 如果您想知道我想要什么……或者我拖着您一起走是想得到什么，为什么不干脆多花点时间去读呢？

lines.en: : You might like what you find.
lines.zh: : 说不定您会喜欢读到的东西。

lines.en: : You and these damn book metaphors.
lines.zh: : 你这些该死的书的比喻。

lines.en: : The train is here. Are we leaving or not?
lines.zh: : 列车来了。我们到底走不走？

lines.en: scene black
: Fine, come on. But I can’t guarantee I’ll like whatever it is you’re trying to get me to read.
lines.zh: : 行，走吧。但我不能保证我会喜欢你想让我读的东西。

lines.en: : You don’t have to like it.
lines.zh: : 您不必喜欢它。

lines.en: : You don’t even have to get it.
lines.zh: : 您甚至不必读懂它。

lines.en: : You just have to be there.
lines.zh: : 您只要在就行了。

lines.en: scene nodokatrain10
Despite being pressed for time, Nodoka takes it upon herself to grab a quick cup of coffee from a kiosk near the platform and the two of us just barely make it onto the train before it departs.
lines.zh: 尽管时间紧迫，Nodoka 还是执意要在站台旁的小卖部买一杯咖啡。我们俩险些没赶上，在发车前才勉强挤上列车。

lines.en: Thankfully, there’s enough room for us to grab seats almost directly across from Rin and Otoha, but neither one of us pay them any mind as we don’t want to interrupt anything.
lines.zh: 所幸还有位置，我们几乎就坐在 Rin 和 Otoha 的正对面。不过我们谁都没去理会她们，免得打搅了什么。

lines.en: Even if the “detour” I was advised of is today’s primary objective, it would still be nice if we’d be able to force the two of them a little bit closer together.
lines.zh: 就算她事先告知的那个“绕道”才是今天的主要目的，如果能顺势把她们俩再推近一点，那也不错。

lines.en: I say we as if I play any part in this when, in all actuality, I know I’m only here to keep Nodoka entertained.
lines.zh: 我说“我们”，好像这事儿里真有我一份似的。可实际上我很清楚，我来这儿只是为了逗 Nodoka 开心。

lines.en: But, I suppose that goes both ways.
lines.zh: 不过，我想这也是相互的。

lines.en: Because even if she occasionally does things that shock and appall me, I’m no different.
lines.zh: 因为即便她偶尔会做出让我震惊又反感的事，我也不比她好到哪儿去。

lines.en: If anything, I’m worse.
lines.zh: 要说有什么不同，那是我更糟。

lines.en: She knows this.
lines.zh: 她知道这一点。

lines.en: She knows this, yet she still smiles at me like that.
lines.zh: 她知道，却依然那样朝我微笑。

lines.en: : Would you like a sip of my coffee, Sensei? Act now and you’ll be able to steal a bit of my saliva before it dries up.
lines.zh: : 要不要来一口我的咖啡，Sensei？现在就行动，您还能在唾液干掉之前偷到一点。

lines.en: : I’m good. There are better and less caffeinated ways to obtain your saliva if I really want to.
lines.zh: : 免了。如果我真想要你的唾液，有的是更好、咖啡因更少的方法。

lines.en: : Do you think you’ve saved up enough points for that?
lines.zh: : 您觉得您攒够点数了吗？

lines.en: : Depends. How many do I get for joining you today?
lines.zh: : 看情况。今天陪你来能得多少？

lines.en: scene nodokatrain11
: I wonder. It’s been so long since I awarded any that I’m not quite sure what their value is anymore.
lines.zh: : 我也说不好。太久没发过点数的，我都不太确定它们现在值多少了。

lines.en: scene nodokatrain12
: Let’s just say you’ve earned enough for either a kiss or some light groping and we can call it a day?
lines.zh: : 那就这么说吧——您已经攒够了一个吻，或者一点轻度的上下其手，今天就这么定了？

lines.en: : Is that redeemable on the train?
lines.zh: : 这玩意儿在列车上能兑换吗？

lines.en: : It’s redeemable anywhere you please. Though, I can’t guarantee your reward won’t be cut short by angry passengers if you make a redemption right now.
lines.zh: : 在哪儿兑换都随您。不过，如果您现在就兑换，我可不能保证您的奖励不会被愤怒的乘客打断。

lines.en: : I’ll hang on to this intangible coupon for the time being then. I’m looking forward to finding out that it expires roughly thirty seconds from now.
lines.zh: : 那我就先留着这张无形的优惠券。我很期待发现它大约三十秒后就会过期。

lines.en: scene nodokatrain13
: Unfortunately, it expired in the middle of that sentence. Too bad. And here I was starting to get a little turned on.
lines.zh: : 真遗憾，它在您那句话说到一半时就过期了。太可惜了。我这儿还刚开始有点起反应呢。

lines.en: : So, this book you just released-
lines.zh: : 那么，你刚出的这本书——

lines.en: : Changing the subject as soon as I admit my arousal? How rude.
lines.zh: : 我一承认自己有感觉就立刻换话题？真没礼貌。

lines.en: : You’re always aroused. I’ll have plenty of more opportunities to ask about that in the future.
lines.zh: : 你一直都处于发情状态。以后我有的是机会再问这个。

lines.en: scene nodokatrain14
: You’ve had plenty of time to ask about my writing as well. And yet, here we are — violently penetrating a series of underground tunnels until we’re spewed out on the other side.
lines.zh: : 您本来也有大把时间可以问我的作品。可我们偏偏直到现在——正猛烈贯穿一串地下隧道、等着被喷射到另一端的时候——才提起。

lines.en: : Leave it to you to sexualize trains, I guess.
lines.zh: : 也就你会把列车性化，我想。

lines.en: : Anything can be sexualized if one tries hard enough. And any hole can be penetrated with enough persistence and force. Which isn’t to say one should penetrate all holes, but-
lines.zh: : 只要够努力，什么都能性化。只要有足够的执念和力气，什么洞都能被贯穿。当然，这不是说所有洞都该去贯穿，不过——

lines.en: : Tell me more about your writing. What’s this book about?
lines.zh: : 多说说你的写作吧。这本书讲什么的？

lines.en: scene nodokatrain15
: That’s a good question. What is this book about?
lines.zh: : 问得好。这本书讲什么的？

lines.en: : I feel like that’s something you should probably know as the author.
lines.zh: : 我觉得作为作者，你应该知道吧？

lines.en: : By conventional means, sure. But when one literary work contains so many different ideas, it’s near impossible to simply explain what it’s about, isn’t it? It’s something that must be experienced.
lines.zh: : 按常理说，是的。可当一部作品里塞进了那么多不同的想法，要简单说清它讲什么就几乎不可能了，不是吗？它是必须亲身去体验的东西。

lines.en: : That is probably one of the most pretentious things I’ve ever heard.
lines.zh: : 这大概是我听过最装腔作势的话之一了。

lines.en: scene nodokatrain16
: Let’s just say it’s about the folly of man. Or the pleasures in struggling.
lines.zh: : 就说是关于人类的愚蠢吧。或者关于挣扎中的愉悦。

lines.en: : Sounds boring.
lines.zh: : 听起来很无聊。

lines.en: : You don’t read much anymore, do you?
lines.zh: : 您现在不怎么读书了吧？

lines.en: : I don’t read at all. Though, I can’t quite remember when I ever did in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我压根儿不读。虽然我也记不清自己到底从什么时候开始读过。

lines.en: : I imagine you stopped around the same time you stopped writing. To which I’d say, “how sad.”
lines.zh: : 我猜您是在停止写作的同一时期停止阅读的。对此我只想说：“真可悲。”

lines.en: : There’s a great deal you’re missing out on by living the life you lead, Sensei. But, at the same time, I know there must be plenty you experience that you’d never be able to pull from the pages of a book.
lines.zh: : 您过的这种日子，错过了太多东西，Sensei。但同时我也知道，您必定经历过许多根本无法从书页里得到的东西。

lines.en: : Perhaps learning about my latest work will be the call to action you need to get back into the literary world? It’d be wonderful to have a partner there, you know.
lines.zh: : 也许了解我的新作，正是您重返文学世界所需要的那份号召？有个同伴在那儿会很不错，您知道的。

lines.en: : Is Futaba not enough of a partner for you?
lines.zh: : Futaba 还不够当你的同伴吗？

lines.en: : Futaba is a darling and I would kill for her. But we both know she’s nowhere remotely close to the level we are.
lines.zh: : Futaba 是个可人儿，我愿意为她去杀人。但我们都清楚，她离我们的层次差得远。

lines.en: : How do you even know my level? You’ve never read anything I’ve written. In fact, I don't think I’ve ever read anything I’ve written.
lines.zh: : 你连我的层次都从何得知？你从没读过我写的东西。事实上，我觉得我自己都没读过我写的东西。

lines.en: : Hmm...intuition, perhaps?
lines.zh: : 嗯……直觉，也许？

lines.en: : Or maybe I’m secretly a beloved fan of yours who’s been following you ever since I was a little girl? Desperately awaiting the day her favorite writer returns to the game?
lines.zh: : 又或者，我其实是您的一个忠实粉丝，从小女孩时起就一直追随着您？急切地盼着最喜爱的作家回归的那一天？

lines.en: : That would...actually explain a lot. But I doubt that’s the case.
lines.zh: : 那倒……确实能解释不少事。但我怀疑不是这样。

lines.en: scene nodokatrain17
: It would have been interesting if it were, though.
lines.zh: : 如果是的话，倒挺有意思的。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, life is far too mundane to be filled with fun coincidences like that.
lines.zh: : 可惜，人生太平庸了，装不下这种有趣的巧合。

lines.en: : Is that why you got into writing in the first place? You were too...bored with life or whatever?
lines.zh: : 所以你当初开始写作，就是因为这个？你对生活……太无聊了还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Mmm...no. No, I don’t believe that’s what it was.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不。不，我觉得不是这么回事。

lines.en: : While it may be true that my days lack in color, they’ve always made up for that in...hmm...how should I put this?
lines.zh: : 我的日子或许确实缺少色彩，可它们总会在别的方面补回来……嗯……该怎么说呢？

lines.en: scene nodokatrain18
: Incontrovertible peculiarity?
lines.zh: : 无可辩驳的怪异？

lines.en: : I’m going to need you to elaborate.
lines.zh: : 我需要你详细解释一下。

lines.en: scene nodokatrain19
: Let’s just say I’ve lived a life that not many would understand...
lines.zh: : 就这么说吧，我过的是一种没多少人能理解的人生……

lines.en: : And that the reason I’m so obsessed with books is that there was someone before me who may have inadvertently caused me to...inherit that interest.
lines.zh: : 而我之所以对书如此痴迷，是因为在我之前有某个人，也许是无意之中让我……继承了这份兴趣。

lines.en: : I’m going to need you to continue to elaborate.
lines.zh: : 我需要你继续解释下去。

lines.en: : Would you believe me if I told you I came from nothing?
lines.zh: : 如果我告诉您，我是从虚无之中来的，您会信吗？

lines.en: : As in...you were poor?
lines.zh: : 你是说……你以前很穷？

lines.en: : Perhaps it’s better if I don’t attempt to explain things at all. It’ll only make me appear insane.
lines.zh: : 也许我最好还是别试图解释。那只会让我看起来像个疯子。

lines.en: : Nodoka, essentially everything you do makes you appear insane. An explanation of your childhood won’t tip the scales.
lines.zh: : Nodoka，你做的每一件事基本上都让你看起来像个疯子。讲讲你的童年也不会让天平倾斜。

lines.en: scene nodokatrain20
: Then why don’t you go ahead and picture younger Nodoka as a little amoeba — feasting on tiny aquatic plants to keep herself sustained and protected from the big, scary world?
lines.zh: : 那您何不把小时候的 Nodoka 想象成一只小小的变形虫——啃食着微小的水生植物维生，借此躲开那个又大又可怕的世界？

lines.en: : Or a cute little tardigrade — clinging to a patch of grease in your kitchen sink that you’ve neglected to clean over the past several weeks?
lines.zh: : 或者一只可爱的缓步动物——扒在您厨房水槽里那块您已经好几周没清理的油垢上？

lines.en: : I’m going to picture you as neither of those things because you are a human being.
lines.zh: : 这两样我都不会去想象，因为你是人类。

lines.en: : That I am. And an interesting one at that.
lines.zh: : 我是。而且还是个有意思的人类。

lines.en: : But before I was human, I hadn’t even been a thought.
lines.zh: : 但在成为人类之前，我连一个念头都不是。

lines.en: : To this day, I am not a thought. I am a girl who simply is. And I will continue to be because I can’t not. Do you understand?
lines.zh: : 直到今天，我也不是一个念头。我只是一个“是”着的女孩。而我将继续“是”下去，因为我不能“不是”。您明白吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不明白。

lines.en: scene nodokatrain21
: Exactly.
lines.zh: : 这就对了。

lines.en: : There are things in this world that are beyond comprehension.
lines.zh: : 这世上有一些东西是超越理解范围的。

lines.en: : But what if I told you there was another one outside of it?
lines.zh: : 可如果我告诉您，这世界之外还有一个呢？

lines.en: : Another...what? Another world?
lines.zh: : 还有一个……什么？另一个世界？

lines.en: : An infinite amount of them. Each one remarkably different from the next. And that some things are only impossible to comprehend because we’re not meant to comprehend them.
lines.zh: : 有无穷多个。每一个都和下一个截然不同。而有些东西之所以无法被理解，只因为我们本就不被允许去理解。

lines.en: : What if we’re meant to be somewhere else?
lines.zh: : 如果我们本该待在别的什么地方呢？

lines.en: : What if this world is just a mistake?
lines.zh: : 如果这个世界只是个错误呢？

lines.en: : Then...we live with it, I guess. There’s not really anything else we can do, is there?
lines.zh: : 那……我们就将就着过呗，我想。也没有别的办法，不是吗？

lines.en: scene nodokatrain22
: But what if there is?
lines.zh: : 可万一有呢？

lines.en: : What if we can go somewhere else?
lines.zh: : 万一我们能去别的什么地方呢？

lines.en: : What if someone has been somewhere else but everyone thinks they’re crazy and no one believes them because the idea of another world layered on top of this one is absurd? It’s insane. It’s impossible.
lines.zh: : 万一有人去过别的什么地方，可所有人都觉得他疯了，没人相信他——因为在现实世界之上还叠着另一个世界，这想法实在荒谬。这太疯狂了。这不可能。

lines.en: : If we found it, would they believe us then?
lines.zh: : 如果我们找到了，到那时他们会相信我们吗？

lines.en: : If we could replicate or emulate or simulate another world, would they believe us then?
lines.zh: : 如果我们能复制、模仿或者模拟出另一个世界，到那时他们会相信我们吗？

lines.en: : Or would we be forced to suffer in silence because it’s all too incomprehensible? What happens if we find it? What happens if we go there? How do we get there?
lines.zh: : 还是说，我们只能默默受苦，因为这一切都太难以理解？如果我们找到了会怎样？如果我们去了那里会怎样？我们要怎么去到那里？

lines.en: : How.
lines.zh: : 怎么。

lines.en: : Do.
lines.zh: : 才能。

lines.en: : We.
lines.zh: : 让我们。

lines.en: : Get.
lines.zh: : 抵达。

lines.en: : There?
lines.zh: : 那里？

lines.en: scene nodokatrain23
: So yeah. That’s basically why I started writing.
lines.zh: : 总之就是这样。这基本就是我开始写作的原因。

lines.en: : That...
: That didn’t tell me anything at all.
lines.zh: : 这什么都没说明白啊。

lines.en: scene nodokatrain24
: Sure it did.
lines.zh: : 说明白了呀。

lines.en: : You’re just not meant to get it yet.
lines.zh: : 只是您现在还不该懂。

lines.en: scene black
: It seems to me like that was just an overly-convoluted way to dodge the question. But hey, if you don’t want me to know, that’s fine. I like keeping my affairs private too.
lines.zh: : 在我看来，这不过是用一种过度曲折的方式来回避问题。不过算了，你不想让我知道也无妨。我也喜欢把自己的事藏着。

lines.en: : That’s just the thing, Sensei...I do want you to know.
lines.zh: : 问题恰恰就在这里，Sensei……我确实想让您知道。

lines.en: : It’s just impossible to believe as none of it is based in logic. It’s just something that is because it is.
lines.zh: : 只是它无法被相信，因为它完全不建立在逻辑之上。它就是那样，因为它就是那样。

lines.en: : It’s a feeling.
lines.zh: : 它是一种感觉。

lines.en: : But it’s a feeling that moves me.
lines.zh: : 但它是推动我的感觉。

lines.en: : It’s the only thing that moves me.
lines.zh: : 它是唯一能推动我的东西。

lines.en: : And that’s exactly why I need to figure out how to make you understand.
lines.zh: : 而这正是我必须想办法让您理解的原因。

lines.en: : I need to figure out how to make all of you understand.
lines.zh: : 我必须想办法让你们所有人都理解。

lines.en: : If I can’t, my existence means nothing.
lines.zh: : 如果我做不到，我的存在就毫无意义。

lines.en: : And I will return to what I was in the beginning.
lines.zh: : 而我将回到最初的我。

lines.en: : I won’t even be a thought.
lines.zh: : 我连一个念头都不会是。

lines.en: I lean back in my seat and let the rest of the ride go by in silence — but it’s not because I’m confused or shocked.
lines.zh: 我靠回椅背，让余下的车程在沉默中流走——但这并不是因为我困惑或震惊。

lines.en: It’s because, for some reason beyond my comprehension as well-
lines.zh: 而是因为，出于某种同样超出我理解范围的理由——

lines.en: I believe her.
lines.zh: 我相信她。

lines.en: I wish I could tell you why.
lines.zh: 我真希望我能告诉您为什么。

lines.en: $ nodokaspecial30p1 = True
$ nodoka_love += 1
Nodoka’s affection has increased to [nodoka_love]!
lines.zh: Nodoka 的好感度提升到了 [nodoka_love]!
